name: Mesola (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mesola (an eagle beneath a sun on blue) in a yellow cartouche within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Mesola, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Mesola arms — eagle beneath a sun on blue, crowned, in a cartouche within branches
